%doc: Source-of-truth manifest for the `patch` Bucket table: one row per game update page, written by Module:Patch from {{Patch}}. Property names carry the `Patch ` prefix because Module:BucketQuery resolves every registered manifest from one flat namespace. type/bucket/field/index are the Bucket keys; desc is documentation only.

Patch build.desc: The build number from the release notes, from `build`.

Patch release date.desc: ISO YYYY-MM-DD from `date`; the estimated date while upcoming. TEXT because ISO dates sort chronologically as strings. Neighbouring update pages read it for their previous/next line.

Patch upcoming.desc: True while the update is unreleased, from `upcoming`.

Patch status.desc: Upcoming, Released, or Unknown when neither `upcoming` nor `date` is set: the label on the page's status bar. {{Patch list}} shows it and sorts on it, so upcoming updates list first.

Patch product.desc: What the update is for, from `product`; Star Citizen when unset. {{Patch list}} filters on it.
